title: Privacy Policy
intro: AB Travels (The AB Group) is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use and safeguard your personal information when you use our website or services.

sections.heading: 1. Information We Collect
sections.content: We may collect the following personal information: Full name, contact number and email address when you enquire or book a package. Passport details and travel documents when required for visa processing. Payment information for booking purposes. WhatsApp conversation history for support and booking purposes.

sections.heading: 2. How We Use Your Information
sections.content: Your information is used to: Process and confirm your travel bookings. Assist with visa applications and documentation. Send booking confirmations, itineraries and travel updates. Respond to your enquiries and provide customer support. Improve our services and website experience. Comply with legal obligations.

sections.heading: 3. Sharing of Information
sections.content: We may share your personal information with airlines, hotels, visa agencies and other travel service providers strictly for the purpose of completing your booking. We do not sell, rent or trade your personal information to any third parties for marketing purposes. We may share information with government authorities if legally required.

sections.heading: 4. Data Security
sections.content: We take reasonable measures to protect your personal data from unauthorised access, alteration or disclosure. However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure. We encourage you to communicate sensitive documents securely.

sections.heading: 5. WhatsApp Communications
sections.content: When you contact us on WhatsApp (+91 9909957177), your messages and shared documents are used solely for processing your booking and providing customer support. We do not share WhatsApp conversations with third parties except where required by service providers for booking fulfilment.

sections.heading: 6. Cookies
sections.content: Our website may use cookies to improve your browsing experience. Cookies are small files stored on your device. You can choose to disable cookies through your browser settings, though this may affect certain website functionality.

sections.heading: 7. Data Retention
sections.content: We retain your personal data for as long as necessary to fulfil the purpose for which it was collected, including legal and accounting requirements. Booking records may be retained for up to 7 years as required by Indian tax and business regulations.

sections.heading: 8. Your Rights
sections.content: You have the right to request access to, correction of or deletion of your personal data held by us. To exercise these rights, please contact us at info@abtravels.net.

sections.heading: 9. Changes to This Policy
sections.content: AB Travels reserves the right to update this Privacy Policy at any time. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated date. Continued use of our services after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised policy.

sections.heading: 10. Contact
sections.content: For any privacy-related queries, please contact us at info@abtravels.net or WhatsApp us at +91 9909957177.
